# Guardicore Incident Analysis Dashboard

This dashboard provides detailed analysis of security incidents and their associated network connections. Select an incident to view connection patterns and traffic analysis.

parameters.name: SelectedIncident
parameters.label: Select Incident
parameters.query:
GuardicoreProcessedIncidents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| distinct incidentTitle
| order by incidentTitle asc

parameters.name: RowCount
parameters.label: Number of connections to show (15 minutes related to incident)

content.query:
// Get slot identifiers for the selected incident
let incident_slots = GuardicoreProcessedIncidents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where incidentTitle == '{SelectedIncident}'
| distinct slot_id;

// Connection events per destination port (Centra `count` = events aggregated in one connection record),
// one row per Centra record id, split by direction like the Internet Traffic Connections pie
GuardicoreEnrichingConnections_CL
| where slot_identifier in (incident_slots)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by id
| where destination_port > 0
| extend Direction = case(
    source_node_type == "internet", "From Internet",
    destination_node_type == "internet", "To Internet",
    "Internal")
| extend events = tolong(['count'])
| summarize Total = sum(events),
            FromInternet = sumif(events, Direction == "From Internet"),
            ToInternet = sumif(events, Direction == "To Internet"),
            Internal = sumif(events, Direction == "Internal")
            by destination_port
| top 10 by Total desc
| extend Port = strcat(destination_port, " ", case(
  destination_port == 21, "(FTP)",
  destination_port == 22, "(SSH)",
  destination_port == 23, "(Telnet)",
  destination_port == 25, "(SMTP)",
  destination_port == 53, "(DNS)",
  destination_port == 80, "(HTTP)",
  destination_port == 443, "(HTTPS)",
  destination_port == 445, "(SMB)",
  destination_port == 1433, "(MSSQL)",
  destination_port == 3306, "(MySQL)",
  destination_port == 3389, "(RDP)",
  destination_port == 5432, "(PostgreSQL)",
  destination_port == 8080, "(HTTP-alt)",
  destination_port == 8086, "(InfluxDB)",
  destination_port == 8443, "(HTTPS-alt)",
  ""))
| order by Total desc
| project Port, ['From Internet'] = FromInternet, ['To Internet'] = ToInternet, Internal
content.title: Top 10 Destination Ports (connections)
content.noDataMessage: No connection data found for selected incident

content.query:
// Get slot identifiers for the selected incident
let incident_slots = GuardicoreProcessedIncidents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where incidentTitle == '{SelectedIncident}'
| distinct slot_id;

// Get connections for those slot identifiers and analyze internet traffic
GuardicoreEnrichingConnections_CL
| where slot_identifier in (incident_slots)
| distinct id, source_node_type, destination_node_type, count
| extend Direction = case(
    source_node_type == "internet", "From Internet",
    destination_node_type == "internet", "To Internet",
    "Internal"
)
| where Direction != "Internal"
| summarize ConnectionCount = sum(toint(count)) by Direction
| order by ConnectionCount desc
content.title: Internet Traffic Connections
content.noDataMessage: No internet traffic found for selected incident

content.query:
// Get slot identifiers for the selected incident
let incident_slots = GuardicoreProcessedIncidents_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where incidentTitle == '{SelectedIncident}'
| distinct slot_id;

// Get detailed connection information for internet traffic only
GuardicoreEnrichingConnections_CL
| where slot_identifier in (incident_slots)
| extend Direction = case(
    source_node_type == "internet", "From Internet",
    destination_node_type == "internet", "To Internet",
    "Internal"
)
| where Direction != "Internal"  // Only show internet traffic
| extend ConnectionTime = datetime_add('millisecond', tolong(slot_start_time), datetime(1970-01-01))
| project 
    ConnectionTime,
    SourceIP = source_ip,
    DestinationIP = destination_ip,
    DestinationPort = destination_port,
    Protocol = ip_protocol,
    ConnectionType = connection_type,
    ConnectionCount = count,
    Direction,
    // Centra UI wording for the policy verdicts returned by /api/v3.0/connections
    PolicyVerdict = case(
        policy_verdict == "blocked_by_source", "Blocked by source",
        policy_verdict == "blocked_by_destination", "Blocked by destination",
        policy_verdict == "will_be_blocked_by_source", "Will be blocked by source",
        policy_verdict == "will_be_blocked_by_destination", "Will be blocked by destination",
        policy_verdict == "blocked_by_management", "Could not block",
        policy_verdict == "alerted_by_management", "Alerted",
        policy_verdict == "allowed", "Allowed",
        policy_verdict == "allowed_and_encrypted", "Allowed and encrypted",
        isempty(policy_verdict), "",
        // any other value: replace '_' with spaces and capitalize the first letter
        strcat(toupper(substring(policy_verdict, 0, 1)), replace_string(substring(policy_verdict, 1), "_", " ")))
| order by ConnectionTime desc
| limit toint({RowCount})
content.title: Internet Traffic Connections ({$rowCount} entries)
content.noDataMessage: No internet traffic found for selected incident
